ChatUseCaseTest: two stream retractions cancel all failed speech chunks while keeping earlier accepted paragraphs active and queued; provisional message identity and recovered text remain correct. Existing code-block and stale-revision tests pass.

SayTest: a cancelled queued utterance never interrupts an earlier active process; active cancellation destroys its own process. Global clear still cancels active and pending speech. Fake processes and latches provide deterministic coordination without OS audio.
